lessons: DRIFT TYPE B confirmed at scale: upstream moved ~2,500 commits since the last cycle and the CLI surface rotted underneath the skill while the font pipeline section stayed exact. Next cycle, diff the CLI command registration in packages/cli/src/cli.ts FIRST, before reading any prose.

RESOLVED [CARRY from 1.1.1]: the Kokoro/ElevenLabs hedge was wrong, not merely soft. `hyperframes tts` has no provider argument at all; the HeyGen Starfish then ElevenLabs then Kokoro order belongs to the media-use audio path. Upstream's own tts.md says verbatim: it 'does not accept a --provider or --words flag'. Stop hedging a claim you can settle by reading the command's args.

Kokoro was documented as '8 languages' while listing nine, in six places across four files, for at least two cycles. A self-contradicting sentence survived every gate because both halves were individually plausible. Count the list.

The skill's biggest defect was not a stale fact but a MISSING one: upstream ships `html_dir_attribute_breaks_render` at severity error, and it is the only RTL-specific rule in the entire codebase. A Hebrew skill that never greps upstream for its own subject matter will keep missing exactly the rules aimed at it. Next cycle: grep the lint rule catalogue for rtl/dir/bidi/hebrew before anything else.

Running the bundled scripts found what reading them did not: both default to a 1920x1080 viewport, so the documented invocation analyses a portrait Hebrew composition against a landscape frame. The prose was fine; the defaults were not.

Logged in domain-checklist M3. Fix next cycle.

REJECTED Expert MINOR (verified against source): the reviewer claimed 'seeks to 5 timestamps' is wrong because `check --samples` defaults to 9. It is correct. `--samples` is the layout/overlap sampler; check.ts separately describes 'the five audited contrast frames'. Two different samplers.

Legal-gate false positive to remember: the ordinary Hebrew noun הניסוח ("the wording") matches scan_catalog.py's DRAFTING regex (מנסחים|מנסחת|מנסח|ניסוח) and flips a pure dev-tools skill to REVIEW regulated level=3. Reword to התיאור; do not add a legal notice.

Fixed factual inaccuracy: SKILL.md claimed a bare Latin digit run (2025) reverses to 5202 in RTL and must be <bdi>-wrapped. That is wrong and contradicted the skill's own references/hebrew-rtl.md. A bare integer is handled LTR by the Unicode bidi algorithm; only digits adjacent to symbols (%, currency, range dash) or Latin tokens need isolation. Reworded EN+HE.

Freshness: hyperframes tts is no longer Kokoro-only. Upstream tts.md lists HeyGen (Starfish) and ElevenLabs as providers via $HEYGEN_API_KEY / $ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (ElevenLabs has Hebrew). Softened the flat 'external-only' Hebrew-narration claim, version-gated since the published CLI may still synth Kokoro-only.
